Hi all — thanks for looping me in. We can make a limited, conditional exception to the PO requirement for time-boxed pilots, provided the supplier meets a short evidence checklist and we capture a few controls. Proposed approach below: 

Summary (proposed):
- Acceptance: invoice-only onboarding for the 6-week POC, capped at $9,500.
- Payment terms: Net15 from invoice date (SpectraBridge indicated Net15).
- Duration & expiry: exception valid for a single pilot period, automatically revoked after 60 days from the invoice date unless Procurement authorizes continuation.
- Billing & collections: SpectraBridge to issue an invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.com.

Required evidence before vendor setup (minimal):
1) Completed W-9 for US entity.
2) Proof of general liability insurance (certificate).
3) Signed MSA or cover letter confirming POC scope and spend cap.
4) Point-of-contact for billing and PO owner (for future billing/PO if we scale).

Operational constraints (procurement):
- We will not create a PO; accounting will process a vendor invoice against the exception record.
- No auto-renewals; any production usage requires a standard PO and vendor onboarding.
- If sensitive data will be stored, the security team must sign off prior to any data transfer.

Next steps for SpectraBridge: please send the W-9, insurance cert, and signed MSA (or cover note) to this thread. I’m attaching a short checklist and the temporary-exemption form for signatures. Once we have those, I’ll route to Accounting for a temporary vendor record and confirm the invoice routing.

Attachments: onboarding-evidence-checklist.pdf; temporary-exemption-form.docx

Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
